targets.query:
from(bucket: "ebpf_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "context_switches")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "context_switches")

from(bucket: "ebpf_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_metrics")

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "irq_count")

from(bucket: "ebpf_metrics")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_metrics")

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "usage_percent")
